title: Memory Atom — Product Index (v1)
description: Schema for specs/memory/product/index.yaml. Governs the product index (feature catalog) memory atom. additionalProperties:false enforces D-5 atomicity. catalog entries carry rank (integer) and keywords (array of strings) per AC-C1-4 — these are what Phase-1 catalog.json consumes.

vision_oneliner.description: One-liner product vision (bold statement). Template variable: product_vision_oneliner.

vision_paragraph.description: Paragraph-length product vision elaboration. Template variable: product_vision_paragraph.

users.description: User types and personas. Each entry maps to one <li> bullet. Template variable: users_bullets.

name.description: User type or persona name (e.g. 'Operador (humano único)', 'Tier 1 — orquestradores').

description.description: Description of this user type and their interaction with the product.

catalog.description: Feature catalog entries. Order reflects daily relevance (rank 1 = most used). Each entry maps to one <li> in the ordered catalog list. Template variable: catalog_items. rank and keywords are required per AC-C1-4 for Phase-1 catalog.json consumption.

slug.description: Feature slug used as HTML filename (e.g. 'workspace-init'). Links to <slug>.html.

title.description: Human-readable feature title (may equal slug or be more descriptive).

summary.description: Short description of the feature as it appears in the catalog list.

rank.description: Daily-relevance rank (1 = most used). Consumed by Phase-1 catalog.json generator.

keywords.description: Machine-readable keywords for search/injection. Consumed by Phase-1 catalog.json generator.

capability_map_diagram.description: Mermaid diagram source for the capability map. Template variable: capability_map_mermaid.

non_goals.description: Explicit non-goals / known limits of the product. Each entry maps to one <li> bullet. Template variable: explicit_non_goals.

screenshots.description: Optional visual evidence items. Template variable: screenshots_html.
